findings.problem: Venue Hire retains a wide desktop grid on phones; the form is clipped and the centre copy collapses into a 64px column.
findings.correction: Use a genuine single-column mobile venue layout and preserve reachable controls at neighbouring sizes.
findings.evidence: venue-hire-phone.png; main scrollWidth 640 at a 382px frame; centre width 64 and page height 9,376px.

findings.problem: Hire confirmation falsely promises a response within two working days; no enquiry is sent. Fictional email links also open a real mail client.
findings.correction: Keep the enquiry/email process realistic, ending with an explicit demo-only/no-send confirmation.
findings.evidence: hire-result.png; live dummy submission observed; venue-form.js prevents default and makes no request; README confirms fictional contacts.

findings.problem: Venue Hire accepts 999 attendees despite max=200; errors leave focus on Send and are not associated with their fields.
findings.correction: Respect range/type validity, associate error text, focus the first invalid field and announce errors.
findings.evidence: Live and hosted submission with 999 succeeded; hire invalid focus remained submit button; novalidate custom code only tests required/email.

findings.problem: Coming Soon button on Now Playing is almost invisible; Coming Soon footer text also fails contrast.
findings.correction: Use palette-consistent foreground/background contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.evidence: Axe: button 1.07:1; footer 4.13:1; now-playing-details.png and coming-soon.png.

findings.problem: Poster lightbox allows Tab into background content; landscape menu content extends below its unscrollable overlay.
findings.correction: Contain/restore overlay focus, make background inert where appropriate, and allow menu scrolling in short viewports.
findings.evidence: poster tab focus contained=false; rotated-menu.png; short-landscape menu clientHeight190 versus scrollHeight283, overflow visible.

findings.problem: Venue scroll region is not keyboard-focusable; seating buttons use unsupported aria-selected and booking summary skips heading level.
findings.correction: Make internal venue scrolling keyboard-accessible and correct seating state/heading semantics.
findings.evidence: Axe scrollable-region-focusable, aria-allowed-attr on three zone cards, and heading-order on Booking Summary.

findings.problem: Narrow-phone heading splits Clementine mid-word, footer links break into fragments, and the ticket column overflows internally.
findings.correction: Tune narrow breakpoints and footer wrapping without reducing readable text unnecessarily.
findings.evidence: 320x568-home.png; phone booking/result captures; book-left scrollWidth332 versus clientWidth312.

findings.problem: Homepage imagery cycles automatically for longer than five seconds with no pause control; reduced-motion fallback alone does not provide a general pause.
findings.correction: Add an accessible pause/resume control while preserving the existing sequence and reduced-motion static image.
findings.evidence: main.js repeating hold/fade timers; normal motion controls contain only Menu; reduced sequence correctly selects hero-exterior2.

findings.problem: Location alternates between Wāperiki and Wāpereki; a venue image labelled theatre interior actually shows the exterior sign.
findings.correction: Use consistent location spelling and accurate image alternatives.
findings.evidence: now-playing-details.png versus venue-find.png; venue-theatre.png and theatre1.webp alt.

findings.problem: The Family Group Chat poster is 2,554,815 bytes, much larger than the other posters.
findings.correction: Optimise the existing asset with a visually checked re-encode; preserve the artwork and lettering.
findings.evidence: Pinned source asset tree; poster3.webp Git blob d0908a7ceb5a0b0515c75ee72e9ac5d5373cd7f5.

decisions.issue: Poster dates conflict with page copy or are now in the past.
decisions.recommendation: Preserve the existing artwork; label seasons/productions as illustrative samples and align surrounding copy with poster dates. Regeneration would require separate approval.

limitations: Native zoom Ctrl-plus attempt left viewport1440x900 and DPR1 unchanged; native 200% zoom is unverified.
Linux WebKit is not native Safari/iOS. All phone sizes are emulated.

Original Chrome job stalled on a lazy image in a hidden venue tab and was later cancelled. Its provisional captures/report were unavailable. They are not marked inspected or treated as evidence. Six missing desktop captures were recovered without repeating the whole audit.
The first capture-recovery script missed helpers and failed before any captures; corrected with the same authorised scope.

At most eight captures could have preceded the original lazy-image stall; with 30 retained machine captures and two manual live inspections, the routine capture ceiling of40 was respected conservatively.
